subject: sem() moderated mediation- probit link and R2

messages.author: 381eb8b507a08a17
messages.subject: sem() moderated mediation- probit link and R2
parts:
Hello, 

I am running a moderated mediation model with both a continuous predictor and mediator and the outcome variable is binary (0/1). I am using the sem() function to build the model. My understanding is that lavaan uses DWLS and probit as its default with ordered or binary outcome variables. I am curious, is the R2 generated when rsq=TRUE referring to the McKelvey & Zavoina's pseudo R2 or to an OLS regression R2? 

Here is an example of how I am fitting the model:

fit14=sem(modmediation14, data=data1, ordered=c('SI'), estimator='DWLS', se = 'bootstrap', bootstrap=10000L,  link = "probit", fixed.x=FALSE, auto.var = TRUE, meanstructure=TRUE)

 

summary(fit14, fit.measures=TRUE, standardized=TRUE,  rsquare = TRUE)


Thank you in advance for your help!

Luis

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: sem() moderated mediation- probit link and R2
parts: is the R2 generated when rsq=TRUE referring to the McKelvey & Zavoina's pseudo R2
or to an OLS regression R2?

The only difference is that in OLS the Y is observed so the error variance can be estimated instead of fixed.  McKelvey & Zavoina's R^2 is interpreted as the proportion of variance in the *latent* Y that is explained by predictors, rather than the OLS R^2 being the proportion of the observed Y's variance explained by predictors.

Terrence D. Jorgensen
